issuer: Driver and Vehicle Licensing, Isle of Man Government (Driver and Vehicle Test Centre, Tromode)
note: The Isle of Man Government's pages, saved 2026-10-30 (wave 9) and read again today. Driving licences, age related licence applications: a motor car (with a goods vehicle up to 3050 kg unladen) from age 16. The full licence follows the test with no minimum time on the provisional licence stated; for its first 12 months it is a restricted full licence (R plates, 50 mph; New drivers, regulation 9 of the Driving Licences and Test Regulations 2007), so 16 is held as the full licence's age: a reading, as the table gives the age for a licence for the class, not for the full licence by name. Costs as at 1 May 2023: a full licence for someone aged under 66 costs £45 and is valid 10 years (shorter and cheaper from 66, £14 for three years from 72), held; the first provisional licence (£14) isn't. The Regulations themselves (legislation.gov.im) and the 2026 guide PDF answer 'Request Rejected' (a web application firewall) and weren't read. No identity card is held; the exchange lists weren't read.
